name: Raheenduff
questions: Bedroom 4 (3.91 × 3.7 m) is beside the ground-floor shower room. Is the shower a level-access walk-in or a tray with a step, and could a door be added from Bedroom 4 or the sunroom straight to the garden for older parents and their dogs?

What are the sheds and yard about 100 m north of the house used for (working farm, livestock, horses, contractor)? Are any of the 10 planning applications within 1 km, including the active build, on the fields beside this site?
Is the whole 0.69 ac boundary stock- and dog-proof, and are the hedges on the neighbours' sides (about 35–40 m to the houses north and south) on this folio (WX41232F)?
When were the septic tank and the well last inspected or tested? Is the tank registered, and is there a recent water-quality test? Has a radon test been done?
The house was listed with Phoenix Estates from September at €440k. Has anything come up on survey with earlier bidders, and has the timber frame (2003) had any damp or condensation issues?

ai.why: A sound but plain 2003 timber-frame dormer, 183 m² with three bathrooms and a usable ground-floor bedroom beside a tiled shower room, on a hedged 0.69 ac at €420k. Held back by modest common rooms, neighbours about 35–40 m away with farm sheds about 100 m north, no GP or pharmacy in Oulart, and about 25 minutes to Wexford General.

electricity.detail: Likely mains; not stated, but the house is lived in and fitted out.

water.detail: Private well; 'Water Well' in the listing's services. Ask for a recent water test.

sewer.detail: Septic tank; 'Sewerage: Septic Tank' in the listing's services. Ask its age, registration and last inspection.

internet.detail: Fibre; the listing says 'High-speed broadband available, with speeds of up to 500 Mbps' and BuyerIQ lists '102 Mb full fibre'. Provider not named; confirm on nbi.ie by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Bedroom 4 (3.91 × 3.7 m, timber floor, bay window, built-in wardrobe) is on the ground floor beside a fully tiled 2.3 × 2 m shower room, per the listing and the floor plan.

bedsNote: Bedroom 4 on the ground floor; master (4.53 × 4 m, walk-in wardrobe, en-suite), Bedroom 2 (4.3 × 3.88 m) and Bedroom 3 (3.88 × 3.46 m) upstairs
heating: Oil-fired central heating; solid-fuel stove in the living room
tagline: A 2003 four-bed timber-frame dormer on 0.69 hedged acres off a quiet lane, about 3 km from Oulart and 13 km from Enniscorthy.

pros.text: Ground-floor bedroom beside a shower room
pros.detail: Bedroom 4 is 3.91 × 3.7 m with a bay window and built-in wardrobe, next to a fully tiled 2.3 × 2 m shower room; no conversion needed.

pros.text: Three bathrooms, one full on each floor
pros.detail: Ground-floor shower room, a 3 × 1.9 m en-suite to the master, and a 3.6 × 2.79 m main bathroom with a bath and separate shower.
About €2,300/m²; stamp duty about €4,200. It was €440k with Phoenix Estates from September, so the price has already come down once.
A 0.28 ha lawned plot with tall hedges on the boundaries, a large rear patio and fields on the east side; enough room for the dogs.

pros.text: Detached garage and stores, about 50 m²
pros.detail: A 6.7 × 4.7 m garage/storage room (32 m² on the plan) plus two 5 m² stores; could serve as a workshop or gym.

pros.text: Timber floors and a vaulted sunroom
pros.detail: Timber floors in the living rooms and all bedrooms (no carpet), a 4.17 × 4 m vaulted sunroom opening to the patio, and a stove in the living room.

pros.text: Fibre broadband and a quiet lane
pros.detail: The listing gives up to 500 Mbps and BuyerIQ lists full fibre; BuyerIQ puts the address outside mapped noise zones, on a local lane (L5152).

cons.text: A plain 2000s dormer with modest common rooms
cons.detail: Built in 2003, timber frame, 183 m² over two floors; the living room (3.97 × 4.68 m), dining room (3.78 × 3.96 m), kitchen (4.32 × 3.6 m) and sunroom are all separate mid-sized rooms, with no large family space.

cons.text: Neighbours 35–40 m off and farm sheds about 100 m north
cons.detail: On satellite and the folio map, one-off houses sit on the plots directly north (about 40 m house to house) and south (about 33 m), with large sheds, a yard and an arena about 100 m north; hedges screen the boundaries. Cooney's grain store is at Raheenduff Cross Roads about 600 m south.

cons.text: About 25 minutes to an ED, no GP in Oulart
cons.detail: Wexford General (all-ages 24-hour ED) is about 21 km in a straight line, about 27 km by road; the nearest GPs and pharmacies found are in Enniscorthy, about 13 km.

cons.text: Rural services: well and septic tank
cons.detail: Water from a private well and drainage to a septic tank, per the listing; oil heating and BER C1 (151.46 kWh/m²/yr).
Enniscorthy (about 15 km by road) and Gorey (about 20 km) have about 5 direct trains a weekday to Dublin Connolly, roughly 1 h 45 min to 2 h 20 min.

cons.text: Two storeys, stairs for the main bedrooms
cons.detail: Three of the four bedrooms are upstairs under sloped ceilings; only Bedroom 4 and the shower room are on the ground floor.
